bootstrap_qualification_protocol.CI_upper: nearest-rank 95th percentile of 10000 bootstrap CPI-resample fractions
bootstrap_qualification_protocol.coverage_uncertainty: one-sided lower 95% Wilson score with z=1.6448536269514722
bootstrap_qualification_protocol.qualification_pass: All 15 conditions Wilson one-sided 95% lower >=0.95 (at least 962 successes each)
bootstrap_qualification_protocol.uncertainty_warning: not a simultaneous coverage confidence claim across conditions
bootstrap_qualification_protocol.qualification_failure: BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE; revise only with prior engineer approval, no posthoc data tuning
bootstrap_qualification_protocol.model_details: Beta q~Beta(p*(1/rho-1),(1-p)*(1/rho-1)); Gaussian marginal standard normal separable AR(1)-like covariance and threshold Phi^-1(1-p); CPI independent

proposed_primary_method_v08.method: one-sided cluster-level student t CI on independent CPI alarm fractions

mandatory_prior_qualification.coverage_condition: one-sided Wilson 95 percent lower bound of coverage >=0.95 in every condition
mandatory_prior_qualification.inconclusive_condition: one-sided Wilson 95 percent upper bound of inconclusive rate <=0.05 in every condition
mandatory_prior_qualification.inconclusive_coverage_handling: inconclusive conservatively U=1 for coverage accounting, separately constrained by inconclusive-rate test

proposed_primary_method_v08.limitations: Asymptotic normal/t is unreliable with very skewed rare events; count-only Beta-Binomial surrogates lack spatial dependence; require additional S03 spatial diagnostic and explicit revision if model mismatch
proposed_primary_method_v08.replaces: v0.7 nested percentile bootstrap only if engineer explicitly approves v0.8
